shots.name: gang
shots.js: __G.setHour(15.2); const g=__G.game,M=g.missions; g.tp(12,340,Math.PI); __G.step(5); g.arsenal.give('rifle',90); g.arsenal.equip('rifle'); g.tp(-8,322,Math.PI/2); g.cam.yaw=-Math.PI/2-0.25; g.cam.pitch=-0.1; g.override={aim:true}; __G.step(40); [M.active&&M.active.id, M.stage, g.gang.filter(c=>!c.dead).length, g.state().health]

shots.name: heli
